test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: DFCB is related to LNKJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, OQNM is related to WYVU. To which of the following is JLIH related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (8) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'DFCB’ is written as 'LNKJ'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b997ffbe797cff730c5560986c4d3e38c1e47ea356a703042852ab516c4bbbd.png] 

And,

 
• 'OQNM' is written as 'WYVU'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed050db8f3607248c077ddca24df5694f21a093a907214fee942f0d7914cb09f.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'JLIH' is written as 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c6f21d357430ce9f9e260451d38858df8113227d62e30cef93754330d7a835c.png] 

Hence, "**RTQP**" is the correct answer.
